explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 42 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the clonazepam tablet shortage on 2023-03-10 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 43 months.
The label for NDC 72603030802 identifies Rubicon Research Limited (FEI 3008252295) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1195651 at that plant ended 2023-01-27 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-03-14 — 42 days before the shortage posting.
An earlier FDA inspection 828916 at the same plant in 2013 was also classified VAI.

Multiple manufacturers — Accord Healthcare, Aurobindo Pharma USA, Cheplapharm Arzneimittel GmbH, Prinston Pharmaceutical, Rubicon Research Private Limited, and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA — are listed on FDA's shortage list with current status.
Corvale General holds 246 units with 31 days on hand at current usage.

Per rule, the buyer should check alternate manufacturers A-S Medication Solutions, Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, and Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, which are not on FDA's shortage list today but whose labels name no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-040073.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%clonazepam%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%clonazepam%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-08564c.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('017534e6-49ff-45f3-b88f-2f34cf0cf8fd') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-7844d4.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%clonazepam%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-eb39a9.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%clonazepam%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-8ebabe.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%clonazepam%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-230c61.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3008252295', '3004011473', '3003157498', '3011895410', '1038197') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-6450c5.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3008252295', '3004011473', '3003157498', '3011895410', '1038197') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-e5d3c7.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3008252295') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('rubicon research')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-220d3b.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('rubicon research', 'northstar rx') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%clonazepam%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-83182c.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('72603030802')
